character: Glamorous flagship village of Courchevel. Highest (1,850m), most luxurious, and most expensive. 6 Michelin-starred restaurants. High-end boutiques (Chanel, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Hermès, Gorsuch). Nightclubs: Les Caves, La Luge. Palatial 5* hotels (Cheval Blanc, Les Airelles, Annapurna). Snow-sure, ski-in/ski-out. Iconic apres at Bar de l'Hotel Annapurna.
architecture: Mix of luxury chalets and 1970s purpose-built blocks — bling covers the concrete
dining: 6 Michelin-starred restaurants. Le 1947 at Cheval Blanc (3*). Le Sarkara. La Cap Horn (seafood). Le Bar de Madame (cocktails). La Luge (bar/club/fashion). 50+ restaurants total.
shopping: Chanel, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Hermès, Gorsuch, Armani. Maison Gandy boulangerie (1963). Forum shopping centre. Boutique ski shops (Rossignol, Atomic, Lacroix).
apres_scene: Les Caves (nightclub until 5am), La Luge (bar/club/fashion), Le Bar de l'Hotel Annapurna, Le Bar de Madame (cocktails). Funky Fox (8 beers on draught). Le Strato.
activities_nearby: Pinocchio ice skating rink (4,000m²), bowling 3000, cinema (Cave des Creux), spa centres (Aquamotion, Deep Nature), paragliding, dog sledding, snowmobiling, night skiing Wed/Fri, Cospaillot museum. Drop-in heliport.
